name: fb09-latency-aligned-sustained-rate
hypothesis: The unchanged PN-charge candidate preserves sustained directional rate after accounting for sourced relay delays.
weight_rule: W[post,pre]=budget*count/sum(selected nonself incoming counts); source self-edges masked only in simulator; all cross-side edges retained

encoder.rule: rate_Hz=min(96,176*sqrt(c)); phase+=rate*dt; phase>=1 triggers one ORN LIF current pulse; phase-=1
encoder.initial_phases: (j+.5)/N in sorted root-ID order, separately per side
encoder.assumption: engineered sensory spike schedule; no downstream, geometry or teacher inputs

gates.propagation: At least one steady-window spike in each intended-side PN, DNa02 and motor group; contralateral activity allowed.
gates.contrast: Right-minus-left DNa02 steady Hz changes in the appropriate direction relative to equal-input bias at each center, by >=1Hz and >=2% of max(total steering Hz,1Hz). Endpoint windows are aligned to the fixed PN interval by source-derived delays; thresholds unchanged.
gates.washout: No spikes after 20ms grace; max absolute voltage <1e-4 after 250ms zero input.
gates.stability: Finite voltage throughout, zero-only and pre-pulse baseline silent, maximum per-cell steady-window rate <=250Hz.
gates.causal: All-synapse cut preserves exact external encoding waveform and silences downstream; the retained ORN-to-ORN recipient may change. A separate downstream-only cut retains sensory wiring, preserves all ORN counts and silences downstream. Each DNa02 incoming cut silences its endpoint/motors without renormalization. All controls must preserve external drive and stability/washout.

selection: One unchanged candidate; all original pulse gates plus latency-aligned directional thresholds must pass.
stop_condition: Close after one capped assay and conditional controls; no window/parameter selection or training.
seed_reason: Fixed graph, inputs and reset; no random draws.

projection_dynamics.reset: candidate - spike*1.1; at most one spike per millisecond; suprathreshold residual retained
projection_dynamics.scope: two projection neurons only; other cells use unchanged base LIF; no synaptic filter

measurement.definition: Count each DNa02 over the common PN interval delayed by its sourced corridor length; original simultaneous counts also recorded.
measurement.limitation: Historically informed change of measurement definition; not independent confirmation or simultaneous-window robustness.
